headline: The story of Super Mario
title: The Story of Super Mario Bros | From Jumpman to Mario | Classic Games
video_script: Super Mario Bros came out in nineteen eighty five on Nintendo's NES, created by Shigeru Miyamoto. Mario first appeared in the nineteen eighty one game Donkey Kong, where he was called Jumpman. Mario is a plumber who rescues the Princess from Bowser. It is one of the most famous games in the world. What is your favourite Mario game? Comment below!
description: Super Mario Bros (1985, NES) by Shigeru Miyamoto. Mario first appeared as Jumpman in Donkey Kong (1981).
